problem_text:
A shipping company needs to process 8 cargo shipments through 8 specialized port terminals.

Each shipment consists of a sequence of handling operations represented as (Terminal, Duration) pairs, where each pair specifies the terminal where the operation must occur and the time required to complete it. The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the handling operations must be performed.

Shipment details:
* S1 requires the sequence: (T2, 5) → (T4, 3) → (T3, 3) → (T6, 9) → (T5, 3) → (T8, 8) → (T1, 4) → (T7, 2)
* S2 requires the sequence: (T5, 8) → (T6, 8) → (T1, 3) → (T7, 3) → (T4, 1) → (T3, 2) → (T8, 3) → (T2, 2)
* S3 requires the sequence: (T7, 5) → (T5, 7) → (T1, 3) → (T3, 9) → (T6, 8) → (T8, 5) → (T4, 6) → (T2, 3)
* S4 requires the sequence: (T7, 2) → (T3, 6) → (T2, 9) → (T6, 7) → (T1, 5) → (T4, 8) → (T5, 1) → (T8, 3)
* S5 requires the sequence: (T6, 7) → (T2, 2) → (T4, 6) → (T7, 4) → (T5, 2) → (T1, 6) → (T3, 3) → (T8, 4)
* S6 requires the sequence: (T4, 5) → (T5, 1) → (T7, 10) → (T3, 10) → (T8, 3) → (T2, 5) → (T6, 4) → (T1, 9)
* S7 requires the sequence: (T2, 7) → (T3, 6) → (T4, 10) → (T8, 6) → (T1, 4) → (T6, 6) → (T5, 8) → (T7, 3)
* S8 requires the sequence: (T1, 2) → (T6, 1) → (T4, 6) → (T2, 5) → (T8, 4) → (T7, 2) → (T3, 1) → (T5, 4)

Each handling operation must run continuously without interruption once it begins, and each terminal can only process one operation at a time. The objective is to determine the processing schedule for all operations across the terminals so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
